_comment: Known accessibility debts, so CI is green today and any NEW serious/critical violation fails. Each entry names its audit finding. Selectors are exact axe targets, or a regex written /like this/. Delete an entry when it is fixed. See e2e/a11y.e2e.ts.

axe.note: Only these offenders: the ghost add buttons (one per folder group, and + new project) sit directly in role=tree / role=group, where only treeitem/group are allowed (critical). Any other unallowed child of the tree fails. Tree-first rebuild (Phase 2) should fix the structure.
The [x]/[ ] tick in the directory: its aria-label does not contain its visible text, so voice control can't target it by what it shows.
The hover chevron that shoves a card to the next lane is under 24x24 with neighbours too close (WCAG 2.2 2.5.8).

motion.note: The reduced-motion rule is `* { transition-duration: 0 }`, which does not reach ::before/::after; the pane handle's line still fades.
